title: A Bark from the Other Side
synopsis: Rex hears another puppy across the brook. A small excavator begins a walking bridge to Green Gate Farm, and Molly becomes a new neighbor.
continuity_state: Before: Pine Park is open and the brook has no direct foot crossing. After: Green Gate Farm, Farmer Ruth, Mr. Lee, Molly and the brook are introduced. A fenced footbridge job begins beyond Pine Park. Jack sketches a dotted, not yet built, bridge.
